scope: boot component ordered write visibility, not die closure
checks: stalled final stack prevents table publication and marker retirement
static read fails closed before HBM write
out-of-order sector fails closed before HBM write
1024 golden RoPE sectors exact through SECDED, exhaustive SRAM errors handled
short table rejected at first address discontinuity code1

model.boot_cost: One cycle blocks the next input while finalizing each BOOT_END; pending write stall is necessarily honored until ordered visibility handoff. Boot remains off token path.
model.hardware: One table-sector versus existing-count comparator, 4-bit pending-write reduction, existing fault/status gating. No added pipeline, macro, or array.

interface: w_rdy transfers ownership to an ordered write service whose subsequently accepted reads observe accepted writes; adapters without this guarantee must defer w_rdy to physical completion.
